group_assignment.rule: one per numeric type; rank then reject repeated original image; all Screws collection restricted to gallery

limits: Single author crop identity diagnostic only, not localization, full-image completeness or BOM counts.
Screws gallery labels retain the existing project numeric-type projection and its semantic uncertainty.
FOD label covers one annotated target and does not certify all visible objects.
Original source group is correlation control, not a physical object, independent video or session certification.
A new cross-class unprefixed aggregate is an additional sensitivity constraint, not a changed original group or split.
Calibrating with known exposed outcomes cannot make this a new holdout.
Small crops remain; no size exclusion, no upsampled-detail claim, and no automatic substitution after pixel QA failure.
No inference or embedding implementation/parameters are selected here. Root decides feasibility/pixel QA first.
